summary: Verified the reported Turkish bug fix (PublicLayout header/mobile/footer CTA relabel + retarget) and full backend regression for gallery event create + expiry quota gate. UI (desktop @1920 + mobile @390): data-testid cta-vesikalik-panel text is now 'Stüdyo Paneli' and clicking navigates to /studyo (studio-email visible). The string 'Vesikalık Paneli' no longer appears anywhere in the public header or footer. The footer link is now 'Stüdyo Paneli' → /studyo. Mobile: m-cta-vesikalik-panel reads 'Stüdyo Paneli' and navigates to /studyo. Regression: /studyo login with studio1@test.com/Test1234 lands on /studyo/panel; /studyo/vesikalik renders studio-vesikalik shell; /vesikalik member page still exists (renders Fotuber Vesikalık Firma Paneli login). Backend pytest 3/3 PASS: (a) /api/studio/me returns membership.plan=gold for studio1; (b) POST /api/studio/gallery/events with {name, client_name, client_phone:'05551234567'} returns event with id + client_phone echoed exactly, cleaned up via DELETE; (c) Registered a fresh studio, force-expired via Mongo (trial_end + paid_until in past, plan=trial), then POST /api/studio/gallery/events → HTTP 402 with detail starting '[UPGRADE]'. AI clothing edit NOT triggered. Real PayTR NOT completed.
